reviews.title: Awesome HDD’s
reviews.comment: So far so good. I sees a few complaints but mine have been working non stop since my purchase. Also the noise level is close to none. I spend most of my time in the same room as the product these are installed in and I don’t hear a peep. The storage capacity is more than I will need for a while. The price was very competitive for the market when I purchased. Will be sure to purchase more once these are filled up since the quality of these is so good.
reviews.author: chillywill

reviews.title: Buyer Beware!!!
reviews.comment: I bought what I thought was a retail 14tb IronWolf Pro, seller was GO VIRTUAL IT STORE.  The drive arrived in an Amazon box, inside was the drive in an anti-static bag, no traditional hard drive box, just the drive wrapped in bubble wrap.  I was skeptical right out of the gate but installed the HD in my QNAP NAS. Immediately I noticed it is MUCH louder than my other Seagate drives.  I immediately checked the warranty on the Seagate website and found the drive had no warranty.  I contacted the seller, and they informed me that was correct, there is no manufacturers 5 year warranty, but they offered a 1 year warranty.  I paid near retail price for what I thought was a retail drive.  I am just done buying hard drives on Amazon.  The details need to be clearer on what type of drive you are actually buying, is it retail, OEM, bulk, and more importantly what warranty you are getting.  If I go back to that same listing 2 days after receiving it, the same drive is listed by another seller and the listing details states there is a "3-Year-Manufacturer" warranty which is shenanigans, because the manufacturer offers a 5 year warranty on the IronWolf Pro drives.  Big waste of time and money.
reviews.author: William J Benz

reviews.title: "Seagate" the GREATEST IN HD's
reviews.comment:
I have used Seagate for at least 30 years and have maybe had 2 problems, which Seagate corrected fast and professionally as always. I have always been satisfied with their products and great customer service. I have 4 operating computers which each has 6 HD and have worked very well for several years. I also have "2" 8 HD servers and 2 "4" HD servers I use for video like movies and TV series and they are also working very well for years.  All Seagate.  In my life working with computers (36 years) I've always used Seagate and never received any promotions, cut price or free hard drives. Needless to say Seagate makes an outstanding product and customer service that will last a very long.  That has been my experience, I truly believe that you who decide to purchase Seagate will be making a wise decision and have the same great experience I have had for years.  Seagate, a great product.
Gary
